name: PigeonKnight
description: Sir Reginald, the Pigeon Knight: a plump city pigeon in plate armour. Flock (pigeons gather and peck), Baguette Lance (3-hit combo), Coo of Challenge (taunts everything, bosses too), Flap (hop + glide), Statue Day (hundreds of pigeons dive-bomb, then he lands on a giant statue of himself).
